$comment: The holding (docs/design/holding.md). offlineCapHours: the most time away a station keeps earning (GAME DESIGN, 48 h); heartbeatMs: how often the open holding scene calls GET /api/holding; cameraMarginTiles: how far past every edge of the layout the camera may scroll into the void, so the HUD's corner panels never cover the shore or Kesh's rock (Task 4b). awayCardMinMs: an absence at least this long (between two heartbeats) is summed up in the While you were away card (Task 7, 30 min); toastMs: how long a toast holds before it blinks out; toastMax: how many toasts stack; sleepSitMs: how long the Kindled sits against the post (or stands, without a sit row) before the cut to the sleep screen; sleepMs: how long the sleep screen holds before the log-out lands on the start screen. layouts: tile templates in the rooms' style drawn with the shore rule, legend: . ground, # the edge (void, solid; everything outside the template is void too), W the Writ post, S the holding store, K the weapon rack (M2 Task 8), T a twisted tree, R the stone outcrop, P the start. stations: each with its id (stations.json), kind and parts (a tile rectangle and its interact point, a ground tile beside it; the trees have one part per tree and share one basket; a part's optional sheet draws it from another prop sheet its kind allows, STATION_PART_SHEETS: every other tree is prop-twisted-tree-2); reserved marks a spot kept for a later task (plain ground, no prop, no Use; the weapon rack was one until Task 8, and no spot is reserved today). plots: four 6 x 6 rectangles in a loose ring round the post (Task 5), each with a permanent id (the basket is basket:<id>, in the ledger), its rect and its station: a 1 x 1 rect at the plot's centre (the signpost, a pillar once the plot is named) and its interact point just south of it; the plots in order belong to Writ line 1, linePlots per line. landing: where the boat ties up later, on the south shore. kesh: Kesh's needle of rock off the south-east shore (a solid prop in the void) and the Talk spot across the water (Task 4). GAME DESIGN's starting layout (2026-10-18); holdingLayoutProblems checks every placement rule.
